sentences.en: The grocery store had to throw away food due to spoilage.
sentences.zh: 这家杂货店因为食品变质而不得不丢弃食物。

sentences.en: Proper storage can prevent the spoilage of fruits and vegetables.
sentences.zh: 适当的储存可以防止水果和蔬菜的变质。

sentences.en: The company's reputation suffered from reports of food spoilage in their warehouses.
sentences.zh: 该公司因其仓库中的食品变质报告而声誉受损。
